In an XBT Lightning test wallet, open Funding and look under Balance Details. A positive, current On-chain available before fee amount appears in green. Compare it with Lightning Node Settings → Node and channel balances after refreshing. Funding shows the amount in your selected unit and Settings shows sats.

When a reserve applies, compare the green available amount with the confirmed on-chain total. Hide balances and check that the green amount is hidden too. With zero available or stale data, check that the value is not highlighted. Use test data only.
